name: Dying
description:
Your Wounds have reached their maximum. You gain the Stunned condition and cannot recover Stamina while Dying. You suffer a -1 dice penalty to all other checks you make.

At the beginning of your next turn you must make a Death Check using your highest Attribute (Difficulty 4, Complexity 1). Each failure raises the Difficulty by 1; if it would rise above 6, you die. Success, an adjacent ally's Mind (Medicine) check, spending an Inspiration, or any effect that reduces your Wounds ends this effect.
